script:
set -e
git -C /workspace/pod-runtime pull --ff-only >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
STAGE=/workspace/atlas-stage/atlas/kazbek-c10
rm -rf /workspace/atlas-stage && mkdir -p $STAGE
python3 /workspace/pod-runtime/pod/build_atlas.py /workspace/scenes/kazbek-run-c10 /workspace/gt $STAGE --cell-m 0.5 --tile 512 --zooms 4
python3 -c "from huggingface_hub import HfApi; HfApi().upload_large_folder(folder_path='/workspace/atlas-stage', repo_id='miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets', repo_type='dataset', print_report=False)"
echo ATLAS-V1-VAULTED
